svg.title: IC Blob Storage authority boundaries
svg.desc: Six distinct responsibilities: the tenant acts within its own service and namespace and retains or releases references; the trusted uploader prepares manifests and uploads with exact tenant permission; the configured verifier independently checks the complete file and attests observed availability; the installed operator inspects and reconciles service operations and performs authorised recovery; the provider stores and serves bytes and supplies provider evidence; the application owns integration, publication and reference use. Controller status grants no implicit tenant, uploader, verifier or operator authority. Upload completion, provider deletion and the end of billing are separate facts.

g.text: IC BLOB STORAGE · SERVICE CONTRACT
Who is responsible for what?
Authority is explicit and scoped. One role does not automatically grant another.
OWNERSHIP & USE
Tenant
Acts within its own service and namespace.
Requests admission; retains or releases references.
A file digest alone grants no tenant access.
PERMITTED TRANSFER
Uploader
Prepares the manifest and transfers file bytes.
Needs installed trust and exact tenant permission.
Upload progress is not verification evidence.
COMPLETION EVIDENCE
Verifier
Independently fetches and checks the complete file.
Attests its root, length, metadata and observation.
Completion does not prove future retention.
SERVICE OPERATIONS
Operator
Inspects and reconciles retained service operations.
Performs explicitly authorised recovery.
Operator status grants no tenant or verifier role.
EXTERNAL STORAGE
Provider · Caffeine
Stores and serves the file bytes.
Supplies retention, deletion and billing evidence.
Deletion and the end of billing are separate facts.
CONSUMER INTEGRATION
Application
Owns publication and durable operation tracking.
Uses confirmed references and manages their lifetime.
Uses the service API and preserves its boundaries.
ic-blob-storage enforces role bindings, limits and recorded transitions.
Controller status grants no implicit tenant, uploader, verifier or operator authority.
